consensusRules.threshold: Score difference > 1 run, wicket difference >= 1, status contradiction, or winner mismatch triggers providersAgree = false
consensusRules.singleProviderBehavior: If only 1 authoritative provider is active and valid, consensus is satisfied (providersAgree = true, providersAvailable = 1)
consensusRules.conflictBehavior: When 2 or more providers disagree on material fields, triggers CONFIDENCE_STATES.CONFLICT and strictly halts settlement authorization
consensusRules.staleHandling: If provider data age > 300s, confidence engine marks feed STALE
